tasks.title: Implement sql.js database initialization and persistence layer
tasks.description: Create a shared module that initializes sql.js with an in-memory SQLite database, persists the database to localStorage under key 'web-todo-proofpoint-v3-db', and provides a function to get the database instance. Handle WebAssembly load failure with a console.error and rethrow.
acceptance_criteria: file task/db.ts exists and exports async function initDB(): Promise<SQL.Database>
initDB() creates a tasks table per RFC §5 schema on first call
initDB() persists database to localStorage key 'web-todo-proofpoint-v3-db' after each write (via a save function)
initDB() logs 'sql.js initialized' to console on success
initDB() logs 'sql.js failed to initialize' to console.error and throws on WebAssembly load failure

tasks.title: Implement TaskRepository with CRUD operations
tasks.description: Create a repository class that wraps sql.js database operations for the tasks table: createTask, getAllTasks, completeTask (toggle completed), deleteTask. Use uuid for id generation, zod for validation, and ISO 8601 strings for timestamps.
acceptance_criteria: file task/repository.ts exists and exports class TaskRepository
TaskRepository constructor accepts SQL.Database instance
createTask(title: string): Promise<Task> inserts a row with id (uuid v4), title, completed=0, created_at, updated_at and returns the Task object
getAllTasks(): Promise<Task[]> returns all tasks ordered by created_at ASC
completeTask(id: string): Promise<Task> toggles completed (0→1, 1→0), updates updated_at, returns updated Task
deleteTask(id: string): Promise<void> deletes row by id
createTask rejects with error if title is empty or >500 chars
completeTask rejects with error if id not found
deleteTask rejects with error if id not found

tasks.title: Implement ITaskAPI interface and TaskService
tasks.description: Create the public API interface ITaskAPI and a TaskService class that implements it by delegating to TaskRepository. The service is the module's public boundary.
acceptance_criteria: file task/api/task.api.ts exists and exports interface ITaskAPI with methods: createTask(title: string): Promise<Task>, getAllTasks(): Promise<Task[]>, completeTask(id: string): Promise<Task>, deleteTask(id: string): Promise<void>
file task/api/task.service.ts exists and exports class TaskService implements ITaskAPI
TaskService constructor accepts TaskRepository instance
TaskService.createTask calls repository.createTask and returns result
TaskService.getAllTasks calls repository.getAllTasks and returns result
TaskService.completeTask calls repository.completeTask and returns result
TaskService.deleteTask calls repository.deleteTask and returns void

tasks.title: Implement React UI: task list display and add task form
tasks.description: Create React components: App (root), TaskList (renders tasks), TaskItem (single task row with checkbox and delete button), AddTaskForm (input + submit button). Use useState for state, call TaskService methods on mount and on actions. Display tasks in order returned by getAllTasks.
acceptance_criteria: file ui/App.tsx exists and exports default function App
App initializes TaskService with a TaskRepository backed by initDB() on mount
App renders AddTaskForm and TaskList
AddTaskForm has an input field and a submit button; on submit calls TaskService.createTask and refreshes list
TaskList renders a list of TaskItem components
TaskItem displays task title, a checkbox reflecting completed status, and a delete button
Checkbox click calls TaskService.completeTask and refreshes list
Delete button click calls TaskService.deleteTask and refreshes list
On mount, App calls TaskService.getAllTasks and renders the list

tasks.title: Add error boundary and loading state to UI
tasks.description: Wrap the App component in an error boundary that catches runtime errors and displays a user-friendly message. Show a loading indicator while sql.js initializes.
acceptance_criteria: file ui/ErrorBoundary.tsx exists and exports class ErrorBoundary
ErrorBoundary renders children normally when no error
ErrorBoundary renders 'Something went wrong. Please refresh the page.' when an error is caught
App shows a loading message (e.g., 'Loading...') while initDB() is pending
After initDB() resolves, App renders normally

tasks.title: Add task count warning at 1000 tasks
tasks.description: In the UI, when the number of tasks reaches or exceeds 1000, display a warning banner: 'You have over 1000 tasks. Consider exporting or deleting old tasks to avoid data loss.'
acceptance_criteria: When getAllTasks returns 1000 or more tasks, a warning banner with text 'You have over 1000 tasks. Consider exporting or deleting old tasks to avoid data loss.' is visible in the DOM
When getAllTasks returns fewer than 1000 tasks, the warning banner is not present in the DOM

tasks.title: Add tags and task_tags tables to sql.js schema
tasks.description: Extend the existing sql.js initialization to create the `tags` and `task_tags` tables per the delta schema. Enable foreign keys via PRAGMA. Bump schema version from 1 to 2.
acceptance_criteria: file task/db.ts (or equivalent schema init file) contains CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tags (...) with columns id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(name) <= 50), created_at TEXT NOT NULL

file task/db.ts contains CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_tags (...) with columns task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, tag_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY (task_id, tag_id)
file task/db.ts executes PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON before any DDL
schema version stored in localStorage is incremented from 1 to 2 after migration runs

tasks.title: Implement tagging module CRUD (Tag entity, createTag, getAllTags, deleteTag, getTagByName)
tasks.description: Create the new `tagging` module with Tag entity, zod validation, and CRUD operations. Tag names are normalized to lowercase on creation. Expose createTag, getAllTags, deleteTag, getTagByName.
acceptance_criteria: file tagging/tagging.ts exports createTag(name: string): Tag that inserts into tags table and returns a Tag object with id, name, created_at
createTag with duplicate name (case-insensitive) throws or returns error (exit code 0 on test, stderr contains 'UNIQUE constraint failed')
file tagging/tagging.ts exports getAllTags(): Tag[] that returns all tags ordered by created_at ascending
file tagging/tagging.ts exports deleteTag(id: string): void that removes the tag and cascades to task_tags
file tagging/tagging.ts exports getTagByName(name: string): Tag | undefined that returns the tag with matching name (case-insensitive) or undefined
TagSchema validates name min 1 max 50 chars, id as UUID, created_at as ISO datetime

tasks.title: Extend task module with addTag, removeTag, getTasksByTag methods
tasks.description: Add three new methods to the existing ITaskAPI interface and implementation: addTag(taskId, tagName) inserts into task_tags, removeTag(taskId, tagName) deletes from task_tags, getTasksByTag(tagName) returns tasks with that tag via JOIN. Eagerly load tags in getAllTasks via LEFT JOIN.
acceptance_criteria: file task/api/task.api.ts (or equivalent) exports addTag(taskId: string, tagName: string): Promise<Task> that inserts a row into task_tags and returns the updated Task
addTag with non-existent taskId or tagName throws an error (exit code 1 on test, stderr contains 'not found')
file task/api/task.api.ts exports removeTag(taskId: string, tagName: string): Promise<Task> that deletes the row from task_tags and returns the updated Task
file task/api/task.api.ts exports getTasksByTag(tagName: string): Promise<Task[]> that returns tasks with that tag via JOIN on task_tags and tags, ordered by created_at ascending
getAllTasks returns tasks with a tags field (array of Tag objects) populated via LEFT JOIN
deleteTask cascades to remove rows from task_tags (verified by querying task_tags after delete)

tasks.title: Add UI components for tag display, tag input, and tag filter
tasks.description: Create React components: TagBadge (shows tag name), TagInput (autocomplete from existing tags, allows creating new tag on-the-fly), TagFilter (dropdown or list to filter tasks by tag). Wire into existing task list UI.
acceptance_criteria: file ui/components/TagBadge.tsx renders a span with tag name text and a remove button (X) that calls removeTag
file ui/components/TagInput.tsx renders an input that shows autocomplete suggestions from getAllTags, and on submit calls addTag or createTag+addTag
file ui/components/TagFilter.tsx renders a dropdown of all tags; selecting a tag filters the task list to only tasks with that tag (calls getTasksByTag)
task list items display TagBadge components for each tag on the task
adding a tag via TagInput updates the task list without full page reload
